messages:
rohan: Heads-up — shifting our 11:00 release slot to 11:30 because the DB migration is running late. Can folks confirm smoke owners + rollback lead? Target services: inference-api, router, metrics-proxy. ETA 11:30 PT. Thanks.

lisa: I can own smoke for inference-api. I'll run the usual smoke.sh and KV cache check. :thumbsup:

anya: I can do router + quick integration pings. Will be on call 11:20–12:00.

omar: I'll be rollback lead if needed. What's rollback plan? manual redeploy to previous tag?

rohan: Yes, manual redeploy to tag pinned in the release manifest. Omar, we'll give you the tag and rollback commands in the thread. Can you be ready to coordinate DB rollback? (hope not)

mike: Note: we need FF for new tokenizer—I'll gate with feature flag token_v2=false at 11:25 if things look flaky.

devops-bot: CI deploy job #4821 queued for 11:30. smoke-check task will run post-deploy. See: https://ci.example.com/job/4821

lisa: Quick smoke checklist:
- curl -sSf https://inference-api/health || fail
- curl -sSf https://inference-api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' || fail
- check /metrics for 5xx spike
I'll paste the small script in thread.

lisa: ```bash
# smoke.sh (run from bastion)
curl -fS https://inference-api/health
curl -fS -X POST https://inference-api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":1}'
kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide
```

anya: Router check: run curl to /route/test and ensure 200 and header x-model-routing present.

omar: Rollback commands:
- kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=2
- kubectl rollout undo deploy/router --to-revision=3
I'll be in the handoff channel at 11:28.

rohan: Canary: 10% for first 2 minutes, then 50% if no errors. We'll watch token latency and 5xx rate. mike will flip flag if needed.

mike: I'll monitor Prometheus dash and be ready to flip token_v2 to false at 11:25. Ping me in this thread if you want immediate rollback.

lisa: Adding timing: deploy starts 11:30, canary 11:31–11:33, full rollout by 11:35 if green.

anya: +1. I'll post smoke results here when done.

rohan: Thanks all. Tag for rollback: release/2026-03-18-rc3. Omar, I'll DM you the creds.

devops-bot: Deploy job #4821 started at 1742230200 by rohan

lisa: smoke ok — health and gen test pass, no 5xx, no latency regressions. :tada:

omar: Standing by. If rollback needed I will coordinate patch and DB step.

mike: Flag stayed on safe setting. No action.

rohan: closing loop — proceeding with rollout to 100% at 11:35. Thanks team.
